description: Mean Chamfer distance and F-score (2% tolerance) over the full 178-object ShapeR test set, one condition at a time, all else held at the dataset default.
source_run: outputs_full/ (full-set run); outputs1/ holds an earlier quick-subset run, superseded here

noisy.desc: 100% of points + Gaussian noise, sigma = 5% of object extent

A1_pointcloud_density_and_noise.note: Positional noise degrades quality roughly 3x more (relative F-score drop) than even the most aggressive sparsification tested (10% of points kept).

A2_caption_conditioning.note: All four conditions fall within ~3% of each other on both metrics; even a flatly wrong category label barely moves reconstruction quality.

A3_conditioning_view_count.metric_source: experiments/exp3_viewcount_ablation/ -> outputs_full/exp3_viewcount/results_views_{1,4,8,16}.json, aggregated from per_sample (no stored summary block, aggregated by docs/provenance.md script)
A3_conditioning_view_count.note: Most of the multi-view benefit is already captured at 4 views; 4 views is also the default used downstream for the mask-guided training/eval (see B).

caveat: Single draw per condition (ShapeR's flow-matching sampler is unseeded by default and run-to-run Chamfer spread is ~23% of the mean on a per-object basis, see docs/D and docs/provenance.md). Treat small cross-condition deltas (A2's ~3% spread, A3's 8-vs-16-view gap) as within noise; A1's noisy-vs-baseline gap (~39% relative on Chamfer) and A3's 1-vs-4-view gap are large enough to likely survive that floor, but neither was repeated across seeds.
